attributes.name: Herald's Heart
attributes.powers:
Before you act, summon and defeat the henchman Inger-Maggor or the Herald's Heart is undefeated. If Inger-Maggor is defeated, any 1 character may attempt the check to defeat the Herald's Heart; if defeated, that character adds it to his hand, and you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from.

Display the Herald's Heart next to the scenario to succeed at your check to defeat the villain Corrupted Herald.
